lines.beaver: 김 대리님, 내일 날씨 자료 나왔어요?
lines.beaver_en: Mr. Kim, is tomorrow's weather data out?
lines.beaver_roman: Gim daerinim, naeil nalssi jaryo nawasseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 내일 아침부터 눈발이 날리기 시작해요.
lines.en: Yes, snow starts falling tomorrow morning.
lines.roman: Ne, naeil achimbuteo nunbari nalligi sijakaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will it snow a lot? I'm worried about my commute home.
lines.learner: 밤에는 함박눈으로 바뀌어서 많이 쌓일 거예요.
lines.en: At night it turns into big snowflakes and will pile up.
lines.roman: Bameneun hambangnuneuro bakkwieoseo mani ssail kkeoyeyo.

lines.learner: 기온은 영하 3도인 데 비해 체감은 영하 10도예요.
lines.en: It's minus 3, but it feels like minus 10.
lines.roman: Gioneun yeongha samdoin de bihae chegameun yeongha sipdoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 바람이 많이 부나 봐요. 산 쪽은 괜찮아요?
lines.beaver_en: It must be windy. Are the mountains okay?
lines.beaver_roman: Barami mani buna bwayo. San jjogeun gwaenchanayo?
lines.learner: 산간 지역은 눈사태 위험이 있어서 주의해야 해요.
lines.en: Mountain areas risk avalanches, so be careful.
lines.roman: Sangan jiyeogeun nunsatae wiheomi isseoseo juuihaeya haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Car windows will freeze too.
lines.learner: 네, 아침에는 차 유리에 성에가 낄 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, frost will form on car windows in the morning.
lines.roman: Ne, achimeneun cha yurie seonge kkil kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 참, 저 다음 달 초순에 태국 출장 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Oh, I'm going on a business trip to Thailand early next month.
lines.beaver_roman: Cham, jeo daeum dal chosune Taeguk chuljang gayo.
lines.learner: 다음 달 초는 건기라서 날씨가 좋을 거예요.
lines.en: Early next month is the dry season, so the weather will be nice.
lines.roman: Daeum dal choneun geongiraseo nalssiga joeul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 비는 안 와요? 호우가 잦다고 들었는데요.
lines.beaver_en: No rain? I heard heavy rain is common.
lines.beaver_roman: Bineun an wayo? Houga jattago deureonneundeyo.
lines.learner: 호우는 우기에 많은 데 비해 건기에는 드물어요.
lines.en: Heavy rain is common in the rainy season, rare in the dry.
lines.roman: Houneun ugie maneun de bihae geongieneun deumureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It'll be hot though, right? What about the discomfort index?
lines.learner: 의외로 습도가 낮아서 불쾌지수는 높지 않아요.
lines.en: Surprisingly, humidity is low, so it's not high.
lines.roman: Uioero seuptoga najaseo bulkwaejisuneun nopjji anayo.

lines.beaver: 날씨에 대해 더 알려 줄 게 있어요?
lines.beaver_roman: Nalssie daehae deo allyeo jul kke isseoyo?
lines.learner: 가끔 오후에 벼락이 칠 수 있으니 조심하세요.
lines.en: Lightning may strike in the afternoon, so be careful.
lines.roman: Gakkeum ohue byeoragi chil ssu isseuni josimhaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I'll prepare well thanks to you.
lines.en: Not at all. Have a good trip.
